page.overview:
Who is Blade Brothers?

The , also known as Swordmasters, are characters in .

The are self-trained swordsmen, and have each won the fighting tournament at the . If trains with them, they will grant him various techniques for his , generally in the form of . Each brother resides within his own dojo, although 's is the only one that is actually a building; the other reside within caves, graves, and even hollowed-out . Each of the who award with use the , which allows them to control 's body and demonstrate the technique. The other three instead use "visualization training," and tell to focus on his performing more ably.

Although must visit and learn the in order to complete the game, the other are completely optional. can sometimes train with a as soon as he finds him, but they usually require him to have achieved a certain accomplishment before they will teach him. Furthermore, the three who upgrade 's previously-learned techniques can only be found after with the other .
